candidate_text: Codex multi-agent v2 now emits completion-only `subAgentActivity` thread items with canonical agent paths, and v2 clients must stop assuming legacy collab begin/end pairs for those tools. PR: https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/27007
evidence_notes: The PR compatibility note says app-server v2 clients must handle completion-only `subAgentActivity` items.
The schema adds `SubAgentActivityKind` and a `subAgentActivity` thread-item shape.
Event mapping and thread history both expose the item to app-server consumers.
The PR says legacy v1 collaboration behavior is unchanged.

claims.text: Multi-agent v2 now emits completion-only `subAgentActivity` thread items.
App-server v2 clients that consumed legacy collaboration begin/end pairs must handle the new item.

decision.reason: The PR changes a concrete app-server v2 protocol shape used by multi-agent operators.

caveats: The change is scoped to multi-agent v2.
Legacy v1 collaboration behavior is unchanged.
